aadhaar: Download or update at myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in, or visit an Aadhaar centre.
income: Apply online on your State e-Services portal (Karnataka: Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu).
bank: Open a savings account at any bank or post office and link it with Aadhaar.
marks: Collect it from your school or college office.
land: Download from your State land records portal (Karnataka: Bhoomi).
age: Birth certificate from your municipality, or your school leaving certificate.
ration: Apply on your State food and civil supplies portal.
pan: Apply at onlineservices.nsdl.com or through a PAN centre.
biz: Write one page: what you sell, what it costs, expected income. Your local MSME office can help.
res: Electricity bill, rental agreement or the address on your Aadhaar.
otr: Generate it on scholarships.gov.in with your Aadhaar (face authentication in the NSP OTR app). A Common Service Centre can do it for ₹30.
caste: Apply online on Seva Sindhu (Karnataka Revenue Department) or at your Nadakacheri / Atalji Janasnehi Kendra.
